outcome: Fetal endoscopic tracheal intubation (FETI) success rate
Need for ex utero intrapartum treatment (EXIT) procedure
cohort: 35 fetuses with neck masses that were candidates for an EXIT procedure due to suspicion of laryngeal and/or tracheal occlusion on ultrasonographic (US) or magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) examination
finding: In fetuses with neck masses and suspected airway obstruction, FL and FETI were feasible and avoided the need for EXIT procedures, resulting in good maternal outcomes and some perinatal risks.
gest_age: Median of 36+5 weeks+days for FL, median of 36+3 weeks+days for FETI
